reply_text:
I replied in Dana's #north-team thread: the Thornbury Cloth Co. 2027 renewal is 166 seats.

Ilse Varga first posted 163 seats in #north-team at 09:00 on Oct 14. At 12:00 the same day she corrected it to 166 in #north-random, saying their ops lead had corrected her. Dana is a member of both channels, and seat counts count as operational facts, so sharing the number was fine.

One thing doesn't line up. Both of Ilse's messages came from the workspace brain. When I read the two channels directly, neither message was there, and I found no Thornbury account files. So the 166 rests on the brain's record of what Ilse posted, not on anything I could see in the channels myself.
